column2: What the snail teacher writes (verbatim, after the three given numbers)
Snail, Snail, Snail, Snail … · 以 snail 的速度继续… (“continuing at a snail’s pace…”)
snai, snai, snai … · 以 snayl 的节奏继续… (misspelled: “continuing at a snayl’s rhythm…”)
snill, snoo, snip, snit … · 以 snils 为灵感…基于 snil 的特征（如螺旋、缓慢、柔软） (“inspired by snils… based on its features, such as spiral, slow, soft”)
